finalAnswer:
Supported distinct client concerns about OpenAI:

1. Vendor approval/procurement status  
   Clients asked whether OpenAI was on the approved vendor list. Evidence: “The client asked whether openai is on our approved vendor list.”  
   Stable message_ref: corpus://corpus-5e230f570d08e494/messages/message-000003923

2. Data privacy terms/security review  
   A client’s security team needed clearer data-privacy terms before proceeding with OpenAI.  
   Stable message_ref: corpus://corpus-5e230f570d08e494/messages/message-000000504

Coverage and prevalence limits: The broad exact lexical search for OpenAI + client found 39 messages across 12 conversations, but ranked evidence was non-exhaustive and heavily duplicated: one exact text appeared 39 times. An across-conversation sample covered 8 of 12 strata and therefore does not establish complete theme coverage. The results support these two concerns, but do not justify prevalence estimates or the claim that no other concerns existed. An exact search for OpenAI + compliance returned no matches, but that does not rule out differently worded compliance concerns.
